For other uses of the name, see Kristina or Christina (disambiguation) Kristina Adela Corinthos-Davis is a fictional character on the ABC soap opera General Hospital. She is the daughter of mob boss Sonny Corinthos and attorney Alexis Davis. She was born onscreen on November 19, 2002. When aged in 2009, the character was portrayed by actress Lexi Ainsworth from 2009-11 and 2015-23, Lindsey Morgan from 2012-13, and Kate Mansi starting on May 24, 2023. Contents 1 Casting 2 Background 3 Storylines 4 Crimes Committed 5 Health and Vitals 6 Trivia 7 Family tree 8 Galleries 9 See also 10 References 11 External links Casting[] The Hoffman twins The Smith twins Born onscreen on November 19, 2002, the role of Kristina was played between a doll and an infant when the character was first born. No information was ever released on the first baby playing the role.[13] The role was cast with Kara and Shelby Hoffman taking over as Kristina. The twins occupied the role from July 23, 2003 to late 2003. However, they were soon recast with another pair of twins, Emma and Sarah Smith.[14] They first appeared on December 23, 2003, and stayed on GH for a little bit under two years (the middle to the end of 2005). Kali Rodriguez, who is most recognizable as young Kristina, debuted on November 15, 2005 and left the show on August 13, 2008, as the show had plans to age Kristina to a teenager.[15]In May 2009, it was announced teen actress Lexi Ainsworth had been cast in the role of an aged Kristina. Ainsworth first appeared on June 4, 2009.[16][17] Response from fans and critics was very positive and Ainsworth was put on contract on June 24, 2009.[18] Ainsworth confirmed on October 7, 2011 via Twitter she'd been let go and has just filmed her last episode.[19][20] Ainsworth last appeared in the role on November 4, 2011. During her time as Kristina, Ainsworth was nominated for a Daytime Emmy for Outstanding Younger Actress in 2011 for her abuse storyline. Characterization With the SORAS aging of Kristina in 2009, Kristina is initially introduced as a bit of a wild child.[21] Kristina's trouble making ways during her first few months as "Kristina" are described as "phase". She often throws caution into the wind just to defy her parents because of how she grew up.[22] However, several major events in her life, including causing her step-mother, Claudia's (Sarah Brown) car accident and miscarriage facilitate a character transition and Kristina morphs into somewhat of a "good girl". Lindsey Morgan (2013) After much speculation and rumor as to whether Ainsworth would return to the role, several sources reported that the show was looking to bring Kristina back to Port Charles. Finally, on April 17, 2012, TVLine reported that actress Lindsey Morgan had been cast as Kristina and would make her debut on May 25, 2012.[23][24] Morgan explains during an interview that she was unaware what role she was auditioning for as only a vague character description was released instead of the character's name. The producers put Morgan through a chemistry test with her potential on-screen parents, Maurice Benard (Sonny Corinthos) and Nancy Lee Grahn (Alexis Davis), which was something that hadn't been done in years. According to posts on Twitter by Morgan and Nancy Lee Grahn, who plays Alexis Davis, Morgan's role as Kristina is contract.[25] However, on March 26, 2013, almost a year after Morgan debuted as Kristina, Lindsey announced she had been let go from the series. Morgan announced via Twitter that "my time in Port Charles has come to an end."[26][27][28] Morgan last appeared in the role on March 4, 2013.[29][30] During her time as Kristina, Morgan was nominated for a Daytime Emmy for Outstanding Younger Actress in 2013. Characterization The vague 2012 casting call described the character as "soulful, but fiery." New comer Lindsey Morgan describes Kristina as having the perfect blend of qualities from both of her parents. With the 2012 recast, Kristina returns home with a "vengeance" after discovering the truth about her parents' bribing the admissions office at Yale University to get her accepted. Morgan admits that Kristina's actions may be a bit questionable at times, but she only does certain things to get those around her to be honest with her. "Even though she is basically, really, extorting them right now, she's doing it almost for an ethical reason. In the end it's to expose her father--and her mother--and say, 'Hello, this is wrong!'"[31] Soaps In Depth, Lindsey Morgan: "Kristina is the perfect blend of both of her parents, She is very ethical, like her mother. She's very honest and tells how she feels about things, which I feel comes from her mother, who lays down the law. Then again, she's very much like her father because she is very stubborn and can be kind of a hot head."On July 29, 2015, Soap Opera Digest broke the news that Ainsworth would reprise the role of Kristina, set to appear sometime in late August or early September 2015.[32] She reprised the role on September 17, 2015 on a recurring basis.[33][34][35] On September 28, 2015, Frank Valentini posted a Vimeo video on Twitter that showed Lexi saying that she was looking forward to spending more time in Port Charles.[36] In 2017, she brought home her first Daytime Emmy for Outstanding Younger Actress for her LGBTQ storyline. Ainsworth made her last appearance on October 11, 2017, along with Ashley Jones (Parker Forsyth).[37] ABC executive Nathan Varni stated on Twitter that the show has hopes to continue the story in the future.[38] Ainsworth landed a recurring part on the upcoming sixth and final season of TNT's "Major Crimes."[39] On July 25, 2018, Soap Opera Digest confirmed that Ainsworth will be returning to the series and will make her return later in the summer.[40][41] She returned on August 15, 2018. On November 30, 2019, it was confirmed that Ainsworth, who hadn't been seen since September, will return this coming week.[42] She returned on December 3, 2019. On April 10, 2020, Soaps.com confirmed that Ainsworth will return to GH as Kristina during the week of April 13.[43] However, her return was pushed back a week. She returned from April 23 to May 6, 2020. Ainsworth returned once again on October 8, 2020 for only one episode. On January 20, 2021, Ainsworth revealed on Instagram that she will return to GH as Kristina.[44][45][46] She returned from February 15 to April 8, 2021. On September 8, 2021, it was revealed that Ainsworth would be returning to GH as Kristina later in the month.[47] She returned for only one episode on September 22, 2021. On December 1, 2021, Ainsworth revealed on her Instagram story that she's back in the GH studio and will return as Kristina.[48] Ainsworth returned from December 15, 2021 to February 4, 2022. On June 27, 2022, it was revealed on Ainsworth's Instagram story that she's back in the GH studio.[49] Ainsworth returned on August 8, 2022.[50] On September 9, 2022, it was revealed that Ainsworth will return to GH as Kristina again.[51] Unlike her previous returns, it was confirmed that Ainsworth will be sticking around for a while.[52] She returned on September 14, 2022. On December 2, 2022, Ainsworth confirmed on her Instagram story that she's back at the GH studio.[53] She returned on December 21, 2022. On February 26, 2023, Soap Dirt confirmed that Ainsworth will return to GH as Kristina during the week of February 27.[54] She returned on March 2, 2023 and was last seen on April 27, 2023. On May 4, 2023, it was revealed that Kate Mansi will join the cast of GH as a recast of Kristina during the week of May 22. She first aired on May 24, 2023.[55] Mansi is on contract.[56][57] Background[] Parents, Sonny & Alexis The Davis girls, Alexis, Sam, Kristina, & Molly (2024) Kristina was initially believed to be the daughter of Alexis Davis and her then-fiancé, Ned Ashton (now Quartermaine). In 2000, Ned proposed to Alexis, but she got cold feet and called off the wedding after discussing her concerns with him. Later that year, Alexis partnered with mob boss, Sonny Corinthos to defend troubled teen Zander Smith, reluctantly becoming the full-time attorney for Sonny and his enforcer, Jason Morgan. By April 2002, Alexis and Sonny’s growing bond led to a one-night stand, witnessed by Sonny’s estranged wife, Carly Corinthos, who subsequently got into a car accident. In May 2002, Alexis discovered she was pregnant but chose not to tell Sonny due to his dangerous lifestyle. When Jason informed Sonny of the pregnancy, Ned stepped in, claiming to be the father to protect the baby from Sonny’s world. A tampered paternity test further convinced Sonny that Ned was the father. Kristina Cassadine, Alexis' sister, perished in a warehouse explosion orchestrated by Luís Alcazar, targeting Sonny. At Kristina’s memorial, a devastated and pregnant Alexis, blamed Sonny for her death. Alexis later named her daughter, Kristina Corinthos-Davis, in honor of her late sister. In 2016, Kristina’s brother, Morgan Corinthos, died in a car bombing. In 2017, it was revealed that Kristina is roommates and friends with Nurse Amy Driscoll and has forged a close bond with Officer Valerie Spencer. In early 2024, Kristina became pregnant for the first time as the surrogate and egg donor for her sister Molly Lansing-Davis and T.J. Ashford. On August 2, 2024, during a heated argument, Kristina tripped and fell out of Ava Jerome’s hotel suite window, tragically losing the baby she was carrying for Molly and T.J., whom she had grown to love as her own daughter. Kristina called the baby Adela, after her maternal grandmother, Adela Corinthos. This incident sparked Kristina’s vendetta against Ava, whom she accused of pushing her and causing the loss.[58] Kristina is an emotionally volatile and stubborn character, often seen as the family’s “screw-up” due to her impulsive decisions and susceptibility to manipulation. Her intense loyalty and deep-seated need for approval drive her actions, leading to complex relationships and frequent conflicts. Of all her siblings, she resembles her father the most. While navigating her battles with emotional upheaval and her rigid habits, Kristina’s strength and openness render her a fascinating and unpredictable figure in Port Charles. Storylines[] Kristina shortly after birth Kristina was born onscreen on November 19, 2002. Alexis went into early labor in the park and is rushed to the hospital by Cameron Lewis, where her water breaks and she is forced to deliver a very premature baby girl with Ned Ashton by her side. Kristina is named after her mother's late sister, Kristina Cassadine. After her birth, Ned still pretends to be her father, it isn't until Kristina is diagnosed with a form of leukemia in 2004, that Carly tells Sonny that he's her father and Sonny confronts Alexis. Kristina eventually overcomes her illness when she is given the stem cells of Sonny's stillborn daughter with Sam McCall; Sam would later turn out to be Alexis' long lost daughter. Though Alexis initially goes out of her way to keep Kristina away from Sonny and his violent world, and after a court battle Alexis and Sonny agree to share custody of Kristina but she would live full time with Alexis and Sonny would be allowed to see her when ever he wanted. Kristina is officially christened as Kristina Adela Corinthos-Davis on December 24, 2004 with Ric Lansing and Carly Corinthos as her godparents.[59] Sam comforts a shocked Kristina after she sees Sam shoot Diego In March 2005, Kristina and her siblings, Michael and Morgan are kidnapped by A.J. Quartermaine (then Billy Warlock), but Kristina and Morgan are rescued by Jason and his then girlfriend (Kristina's sister), Sam McCall, while Michael was presumed dead for awhile. In 2006, Kristina briefly lives with Sonny and Carly after Alexis is diagnosed with cancer. In November 2006, a young Kristina sees her sister, Sam shoot and "kill" Diego Alcazar. Kristina was frightened to death and for a little while wouldn't let anyone touch her but Sam and she also went into a trance like state for weeks (she wouldn't talk). She breaks her silence when she wishes Alexis a Merry Christmas. Kristina goes silent again when she sees Diego Alcazar actually alive which reveals that he is the Text Message Killer. Kristina is approached by Anthony Zacchara as a way of scaring Sonny and finding leverage. In 2008, after Kristina's older brother, Michael is shot and rendered comatose after an attempt on Sonny's life, Alexis reinforces Sonny staying away from their daughter after the Metro Court Hotel hostage crisis. Kristina and Michael (Garrett) in Mexico. A 15-year-old Kristina returned to the canvas of General Hospital in June 2009, "diagnosed" with Soap Opera Rapid Aging Syndrome after being absent for an 11 month period which had begun in August of 2008. Since her return, Kristina proved to be very manipulative and out of control; her escapades have included dating an older boy, driving without a license, going to clubs and even smoking marijuana, all because of Sonny's absence during her childhood and Alexis' overbearing attitude and high standards. She reconnected with and helped her brother, Michael Corinthos, who had just woken up from a coma. She also starts spending more time with her father and his new wife, Claudia. Kristina discovers her mother's affair with then mayor Garrett Floyd and has to adjust with all the media's interference. She also helps her sister, Molly Lansing understand and cope with the attention. Kristina's boyfriend, Kiefer is abusing her and harasses Michael constantly. Kristina, who is unable to go against Kiefer, sides with him throughout most of his arguments. Claudia (her late stepmother) forgives Kristina for causing her baby's death. After Kristina gets in a fight with Kiefer, she's illegally drives and causes an accident that injuries Claudia Zacchara and kills the unborn baby (Kristina's half-brother) that Claudia is carrying. Kristina then leaves for Veracruz, Mexico, taking Michael with her to get away from the stress. They are later brought home by her sister Sam and Michael's uncle Jason. After much pressure, Kristina decides she is ready to have sex with Kiefer. Convincing Sam to take her to the free clinic, Kristina gets started on birth control.
